name: Targorr the Dread
summary: Deep in the Stormwind Stockade, Targorr the Dread waits among the rioting convicts. His execution was delayed by corruption and neglect, and the Defias uprising gave him a chance to escape.

sections.title: The Butcher of Redridge
sections.body: Before his capture, Targorr the Dread served Warlord Gath'Ilzogg as the Blackrock clan's supreme executioner. He worked from the occupied ruins in Redridge, where his cruelty surpassed even the Dark Horde's violent ways. Stormwind guards and militiamen who defended the borderlands suffered torment and slow deaths at his hands. Across the kingdom, few names were more reviled.

sections.title: Justice Denied
sections.body: After Alliance forces captured Targorr alive, they brought him in chains to the capital and locked him in the high-security Stockade. His execution stalled in Stormwind's judicial and political bureaucracy. Graft, endless paperwork, and neglect kept the courts from delivering the death sentence he had earned. A bloodthirsty war criminal remained in a cell beneath the heart of the city.

sections.title: Uprising in the Cells
sections.body: When the Defias Brotherhood broke prisoners out by force, Targorr seized his chance. He escaped his cell and joined the Defias rioters, turning his cellblock into a slaughterhouse. Warden Thelwater has lost control of the prison. Lakeshire still bears the wounds Targorr dealt its defenders, and seeks adventurers willing to enter the riots and bring back the butcher's head.

faq.answer: Targorr the Dread served Warlord Gath'Ilzogg as a Blackrock orc and supreme executioner. He became notorious for torturing captured Stormwind soldiers, until he was caught and imprisoned in the Stormwind Stockade.

faq.q: Why wasn't Targorr executed when he was captured?
faq.answer: Stormwind's inefficient, bloated, and corrupt legal administration delayed Targorr's execution with endless paperwork. The prison riots erupted before the courts could carry out his sentence.

faq.q: Why is an orc allied with the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: During the prison uprising, convicts of all stripes united against their jailers. Targorr joined the Defias rioters to secure his freedom and slaughter any guards or adventurers who cross his path.
Guard Berton, stationed in Lakeshire in Redridge, offers a bounty for Targorr's severed head. Lakeshire suffered under Targorr's cruelty and wants the execution Stormwind's courts failed to deliver.
Targorr is inside the Stormwind Stockade, in a rear cellblock with other rioting inmates.

faq.q: What clan does Targorr belong to?
faq.answer: Targorr belongs to the Blackrock orcs, among the rogue Dark Horde remnants operating from the Redridge Mountains and Blackrock Spire. They are not part of the New Horde led by Thrall.

angles.text: For humans of Stormwind, especially those with ties to Redridge, Targorr recalls the cost of the kingdom's bureaucratic failures and the ongoing threat of the Blackrock orcs.
Putting down Targorr amid the Stockade riots brings long-overdue justice to Lakeshire's fallen defenders and helps contain the chaos beneath the capital.
